description: This file manages desktop notification sounds, including sound options, playback functions, and conversions for user preferences within the Mattermost application.

methods.name: getValueOfNotificationSoundsSelect
methods.description: Returns the selected notification sound option object based on the sound name.

methods.name: getValueOfIncomingCallSoundsSelect
methods.description: Returns the selected incoming call sound option object based on the sound name.

methods.name: ding
methods.description: Plays a notification sound if allowed, with a debounce of 3 seconds.

methods.name: tryNotificationSound
methods.description: Attempts to play the specified notification sound.

methods.name: ring
methods.description: Plays a looping notification ring sound.

methods.name: stopRing
methods.description: Stops the current notification ring sound.

methods.name: tryNotificationRing
methods.description: Plays a temporary notification ring sound with a timeout.

methods.name: stopTryNotificationRing
methods.description: Stops the temporary notification ring sound.

methods.name: loopNotificationRing
methods.description: Creates and plays a looping notification sound.

methods.name: hasSoundOptions
methods.description: Checks if sound options are available based on the user agent.

methods.name: convertDesktopSoundNotifyPropFromUserToDesktop
methods.description: Converts user preference for desktop sound from boolean string to channel-specific enum.
